runSummary.note: Fresh 11.9.2026 00:15 sweep genuinely searched Profesia, direct company careers, LinkedIn Jobs, Worki, Brigada.sk, Kariera/Zoznam, Praca za rohom, Sluzby zamestnanosti, Pretlak/StartupJobs, Upwork, Reddit/public WordPress communities and public Facebook indexing. Ajax Systems currently lists Business Development Manager (Slovakia), Remote/Bratislava, but the role is sales-heavy and below target ranking. LinkedIn Top4Mobile e-shop admin is no longer accepting applications. Sluzby zamestnanosti surfaced BA admin/customer-care roles, but visible candidates were older, low-pay or qualification/language-adjacent; Zvolen foreign-language support fails distance/language gates. Facebook yielded 0 concrete publicly verifiable hiring posts.
